description: Track the HelloFresh promo/voucher: the coupon code, whether it is active, its box limit, boxes used and left, and for each upcoming running week the REAL discount from HelloFresh’s own price calculator (coupon percent, discount and grand total, US dollars) — with warnings when a running week gets no discount, the coupon percent changes from the week before, the voucher is inactive, or fewer than 4 discounted boxes are left. Answers "is my HelloFresh discount still applying?".

next_box_number.description: Which box this account’s NEXT running delivery will be, counting every box ever delivered (1 = the first box). The voucher’s discount depends on it. Default: 1 when HelloFresh says the first box is not delivered yet; otherwise an assumed 2 (HelloFresh does not say how many boxes were delivered).

name: hf_promo_status
